name: Lincoln Industries Manufacturing of WI, LLC
old_description: Lincoln Industries is the largest and most diverse privately-held metal finishing company in North America. We develop technical solutions that move our customers forward by bringing their visions to life.
about:
Lincoln Industries Manufacturing of WI, LLC operates from Menomonee Falls, Wisconsin. The privately held metal finishing company traces its roots back more than seven decades, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership remains private, and the company does not name its founders in available materials.

The company specializes in precision electroplating and has been expanding its in-house coating capabilities. Its product portfolio includes a range of truck components such as exhaust systems, bumpers, internal cab parts, grab bars, engine components, emblems, and heat management solutions. In 2025, Lincoln Industries launched Fourth Wall, a new division focused on LED display solutions for sports venues, businesses, and outdoor environments. The company describes itself as the largest and most diverse privately held metal finishing operation in North America, though facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not disclosed.

Lincoln Industries serves customers across agriculture, automotive, appliances, motorsports, powersports, oil and gas, tools, and heavy-duty truck markets. The new Fourth Wall division adds sports entertainment, commercial signage, and outdoor advertising to its industry reach.

The company emphasizes technical solutions that move customers forward, citing its expansion into coating capabilities as a way to deliver enhanced value. Its truck business evolution reflects an ability to embrace complexity and automation, while a stated commitment to wellness and continuous improvement underpins its culture.
